title: Stream all episodes / Trending
slide_intent: Distinguish an action from scheduling detail and status, because viewers scan short promotional messages for different kinds of information.
strategic_value: The emphasized Stream word and inline trending icon can connect functional viewing information to Channel 4’s playful type system.
demonstration: Three black lines on a turquoise gradient read Stream all episodes, Watch live Friday 9pm and Trending with an upward sparkling arrow; Stream uses a heavier italic treatment.
practical_value: Compare typographic emphasis for a viewing action with regular text for timing and status.

content_islands.name: Message stack
content_islands.spec: Align the three lines at the upper left, emphasizing only Stream and keeping the arrow with Trending.

content_islands.name: Gradient setting
content_islands.spec: Place the text over the broad turquoise field with a narrow neighboring pale field at left.

reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram’s accompanying case study connects clear typographic hierarchy with playful 4mojis integrated into the typefaces.
reference_purposes.Expression: Three black lines on a turquoise gradient read Stream all episodes, Watch live Friday 9pm and Trending with an upward sparkling arrow; Stream uses a heavier italic treatment.
reference_purposes.Application: The specimen applies italic bold emphasis to the viewing action, regular type to schedule and status text, and an inline icon to Trending.
